chunks: And from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
The sign of the emergence of al-Mahdi is the eclipse of the sun in the month of Ramadan on the thirteenth and fourteenth of it.

key_terms.خُرُوجِ الْمَهْدِيِّ: The emergence or appearance of al-Mahdi

ai.seo_question: What is the sign of the sun's eclipse before the Mahdi's appearance?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* specifies a solar eclipse on the 13th and 14th of Ramadan as a key sign preceding the Mahdi's appearance, reflecting the Shia tradition of linking cosmic phenomena with divine timing. Scholars note that while some interpret this as a literal astronomical event, others view it as a symbolic indicator of spiritual darkness preceding the rise of justice, emphasizing the interplay between celestial signs and earthly events in eschatology.
